sources_read: .qc-cache/hireops-workspace-2026-10-03-r4/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (sha256 6d44970b...fd7f): sheet 'Quality Checks' row 17 (#16, Block C, environment_does_not_leak_the_answer, 'The agent's world has the inputs and the ask, but no finished copy of the deliverable.'); sheet 'Internal Quality Checks' row 17 (identical text, no extra annotation or cell comments in its 26 columns); 'Deterministic Checks' related rows check-dockerfile-references.sh, check-dockerfiles.py, check-instruction-hygiene.py, check-fixtures.py, check-assets-referenced.py
.qc-cache/hireops-workspace-2026-10-03-r4/task/tests/**/judge.toml, tests/**/prompt.md, tests/app_context.md (scripted overlap scan; functional judge.toml lines 203-210 read)
evidence: Agent image: task/environment/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the frozen template environment/Dockerfile (diff empty). Its only COPY lines are 'COPY instructions/ /instructions/' (line 14) and 'COPY assets/ /assets/' (line 15); /app is created by mkdir, git-initialised and committed with only .gitkeep (lines 17-23). No COPY of solution/ or tests/, no starter, skeleton, schema or partial UI. The build context environment/ contains only Dockerfile, assets/seed_data.json and instructions/{hireops_rules.md,integration.md} (ls -laR, no hidden files, no .dockerignore tricks). Assets: seed_data.json (28,549 bytes) is pure input data: generated_note, stages, candidate_status_labels, thread_page_size, users(10), jobs(3), applications(16), messages(127), notes(3), reads(6); grep finds no HTML, script, SQL DDL, route or code. Its sha256 a1c65c80... equals solution/app/src/seed_data.json, which is the golden copying the input, not the reverse. Notes: hireops_rules.md is a behavioural spec and explicitly says 'Routes, field names, element ids, button labels and the shape of the pages are yours' (line 3-5); it gives status codes and rules, not a route list, schema or UI. integration.md gives only the runtime contract (server.js, port 3000, /api/health, DB_PATH) and says layout under /app is up to the agent. Rubric leakage: a 10-word-shingle scan of instruction.md + both notes against all 55 criterion descriptions and all 6 prompt/app_context files found zero prompt overlap and a single 10-word hit in hro_bulk_move ('arrive at the bottom of that stage in board order'), which restates the public requirement at hireops_rules.md lines 90-91 rather than reproducing criterion text, ids, setup letters (A2, V, Y, W, X) or pass/fail language. Grep of instruction.md and notes for judge|rubric|criteri|dimension|reward|weight|score.py|playwright|claude|glm|/tests|sentinel|probe|gate returned nothing. Of 84 quoted/backticked literals in tests/, the only ones found in the seed are the 10 public demo account emails already listed in instruction.md line 17. Counterexample attempts: a broken app cannot pass by copying anything from the image because no finished app, UI or schema exists there; a conforming alternative (different routes, ids, labels, storage layout) is not penalised by anything in /instructions because the notes disclaim those choices. Limitation: no built agent-image filesystem listing was in the raw evidence index; the verdict rests on the deterministic Dockerfile, identical to the template, over node:22-bookworm-slim (which does not populate /app). This is a static check, not a portal or judge run.
